answer: Highest stable-and-useful concurrency on Radeon 8060S for this stack: with the packaged default config, c=2 (24.4 req/min, TTFA p50 0.30 s); c>=4 queues severely (c=8 E2E p50 273 s). With stage-1 max_num_seqs=1 (the config's own TTFA note): c=8 is stable and useful — TTFA p50 0.74 s, E2E p50 8.63 s, 34.9 req/min, audio/wall 1.50. NOT a universal-best claim; this host/config only.
